decisions.reason: The Garamond selection is already represented by a same-message Event; the whitespace-balancing decision does not otherwise change the body typography requirement.
The Fun Fact images address empty space at article endings, not the separate requirement to break up excessive uninterrupted text for reader interest.
The whitespace-balancing methods do not change author names, photographs, sizing, shape, coverage, or source.
The source decision changes article-ending whitespace treatment; it does not change the flipbook deliverable or two-page-spread display behavior.
Providing backup advertisements does not alter the requirement that advertisements render clearly without blurriness.
Creating Fun Fact images for whitespace balance does not change the existing requirement to enhance image quality with AI when needed.
The new whitespace-balancing methods do not change article order, flat-plan use, or placement rules.
The Fun Fact images are a layout-balancing method and do not modify the existing required tribute page or required article list.
The whitespace treatment does not change the magazine's visual-style, branding-reference, or red-color constraints.
The statement that time is short provides context but does not modify the established launch target or deadline.
The same message requests notification when the table of contents is correct but does not change its accuracy standard, completion condition, or page-number basis.
